questions.q: What was Gub-Gub doing at the prison window when Polynesia arrived?
choices: Sniffing the cooking-smells from the palace-kitchen
Watching the guards change at the palace gate
Calling out to Chee-Chee in the trees outside
Trying to squeeze his body between the bars

questions.q: What did Polynesia tell the Doctor he must make Prince Bumpo promise first?
choices: To give him half of the Kingdom of Jolliginki
To tell the King that the Doctor was a good wizard
To bring food and water to all the animals
To open the prison-door and find him a ship
questions.evidence: open the prison-door and find a ship for you

questions.q: Polynesia spoke "impatiently" to the Doctor. What does that tell you about how she spoke?
choices: She was speaking very slowly and kindly to him
She was frightened and spoke in a shaky whisper
She was in a hurry and didn't want to wait or argue
She was teasing him and trying to make him laugh

questions.q: Why did Prince Bumpo want his face to shine like silver?
choices: So his father the King would make him the next king
So The Sleeping Beauty would think he was her prince
So the people of Jolliginki would bow down to him
So he could frighten the enemies of his kingdom
questions.evidence: My prince's face shone like silver in the moonlight

questions.q: What did the Doctor first suggest he could make shine instead of Bumpo's face?
choices: His crown
His sword and shield
His horse's saddle
The palace windows
questions.evidence: supposing I made your crown shine very brightly

questions.q: What did the Doctor make Bumpo do BEFORE he would mix any medicine?
choices: Bring him a looking-glass from the palace
Promise to apologize to the King for the prison
Find Polynesia and Chee-Chee in the forest
Go to the beach and get a ship ready with food
questions.evidence: you must first go down to the beach and get a ship ready

questions.q: What did Bumpo do with the mixture of medicines in the basin?
choices: He rubbed it on his cheeks with a soft cloth
He drank it down quickly in one big gulp
He dipped his face in it right up to his ears
He poured it over his crown and his hair
questions.evidence: put his face in--right up to the ears

questions.q: Why did the Doctor stand first on one leg and then the other while Bumpo's face was in the basin?
choices: He was trying to keep his feet warm in the cold prison
He was worried the medicine might not work right
He was dancing because he knew they would be free
He was tired after standing up for so many hours

questions.q: Why wouldn't the Doctor let Bumpo keep the looking-glass?
choices: He said he needed it to shave with
He said it had been a gift from his sister
He said the King would take it away from him
He said it would break on the long sea voyage
questions.evidence: he needed it to shave with

questions.q: Why did the Doctor feel sorry about Bumpo after they escaped?
choices: He had taken the copper keys and Bumpo needed them
He had broken his promise to give Bumpo half his kingdom
He thought the King would put Bumpo in the prison
He thought the shine might wear off by morning
questions.evidence: the shine will have worn off when he wakes up in the morning

questions.q: Which animals stayed behind in Africa instead of going on the ship?
choices: Jip, Dab-Dab and the white mouse
Gub-Gub, Too-Too and the pushmi-pullyu
Chee-Chee, Polynesia and the crocodile
Polynesia, Jip and the owl Too-Too

questions.q: What was the Doctor worried about once he stood on the boat?
choices: That the ship had too little food for the trip
That nobody was with them to guide them home
That the King's soldiers would chase after them
That the crocodile would try to come aboard
questions.evidence: they had no one with them to guide them back to Puddleby

questions.q: What were the thousands of birds that came down and settled on the ship and the sand?

Parrots coming to say good-by to Polynesia
Sea-gulls looking for fish in the moonlight
Wild ducks flying south for the Winter

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: How Prince Bumpo finds The Sleeping Beauty and marries her at last
How Polynesia teaches Prince Bumpo to speak the language of animals
How the King of Jolliginki makes the Doctor scrub his dirty kitchen
How the Doctor tricks his way out of prison and sets sail for home
